purpose: Establish that `message_delta.usage` top-level is a cumulative parent-only sum across `type:"message"` iterations within one SSE message, and that the context meter must extract the last parent iteration (not the top-level) to avoid an N+1x overcount on advisor-containing turns.

rawLog.reason: The raw NDJSON includes local session ids, MCP server names, and the model's free-text response. This sanitized summary keeps the durable protocol facts without machine-specific or content-dependent material. Raw captures live at /tmp/advisor-spike/{control,out,double}.ndjson on the capturing machine.

control.prompt: Say hello in three words and stop. Do not use any tools.

singleAdvisor.prompt: Please call advisor() now. After you get the result back, write a one-sentence summary and stop. Do not call any other tools.

streamEventCounts._note: Blocks were: thinking(idx0), server_tool_use(advisor)(idx1), advisor_tool_result(idx2), text(idx3). The entire advisor flow lives inside ONE parent SSE message; advisor does not split the stream.

iterations._note: Advisor entry. Has its own context window — never feeds the parent meter.

usageFlat._note: Equals message_delta top-level on the closing envelope.

claude-opus-4-7[1m]._note: Parent model accounting — same cumulative SUM as message_delta top-level.

doubleAdvisor.prompt: Please call advisor() now. After you receive the response, call advisor() one more time. Then write a brief one-sentence summary and stop. Do not use any other tools.

streamEventCounts._note: Blocks were: thinking, server_tool_use, advisor_tool_result, server_tool_use, advisor_tool_result, text — all within one SSE message.

conclusion.contextWindowSource: message_delta.usage.iterations[].filter(type='message').slice(-1)[0]. Fall back to the same envelope's top-level when iterations is absent (single-call equivalence).
doNotUse: message_delta.usage top-level (without iteration extraction) — cumulative parent-only SUM; overcounts by (N+1)x where N is advisor calls per turn
result.modelUsage[parent_model] token totals — same cumulative SUM
result.modelUsage[advisor_model] — separate model, separate context window
conclusion.advisorWireShape: server_tool_use(name='advisor') + advisor_tool_result are CONTENT BLOCKS within a single parent SSE message. The advisor's separate model call does NOT terminate the parent's stream message and does NOT emit its own message_start. Confirmed with 1× and 2× advisor flows.
conclusion.overcountScaling: linear in advisor count per turn — N advisors in one turn produce (N+1) parent iterations whose top-level sum is roughly (N+1)x the model's actual prompt size at end of turn, because each iteration's cache_read includes everything from prior iterations.
